notes.title: Update 1.1.8 out now!!! 3 New characters
notes.content:
Update List
[u]Characters[/u]
Added Character - Grave (Taekwondo)
Added Character - Swizzy (Street Boxer)
Added Character - Aleksei (Grappler)

[u]Gameplay Mechanic[/u]
Added - Air Block 
Changed all the characters air weight/ gravity
Added air launcher to some normal and special attacks.
Fixed known issues with certain characters combo's auto chaining into crouch attacks.

[u]Character changes[/u]
Overall rebalanced of all the characters especially July, Kurai, Tiger, Titan, Takeshi, Veronica and Mars
[u]July[/u]
Changed some of July's move set and animations to match more of a MMA fighter.
Changed the timing in July's beast KO ultimate
Added Flying spinning Anti air kick named Flying Beast Kick 
Removed July's flare kick
Removed July's Anti air knee attack
[u]Kurai[/u]
Changed Kurai height, Walk speed & jump speed.
Changed Crouching sweep animation
Changed crouching uppercut to foot uppercut.
Added new counter ultimate.
Added Flare kick special.
[u]Mars[/u]
Added more chain combo possibilities.
Changed his Ultimate projectile attack.
Fixed some chain combos issues.
[u]Takeshi[/u]
Added tsunami Kick specials
Added High projectile special.
Added more chain combo possibilities.
Changed his Ultimate projectile attack.
[u]Tiger[/u]
Changed Height
Changed Roundhouse kick animations
Double chamber has been changed to a unique move from special move.
Added triple strike special.
Added Roaring Fang Ultimate.
Added VFX to his Ultimate projectile animations.
Removed super punch ultimate.
[u]Titan[/u]
Added vfx to titans special moves
Titan Spinning Punch has been giving to Aleksei.
Fixed issue with titan stomp vfx.
[u]Syd[/u]
Changed timing on Syd Demon Flip Kick.

[u]Minor changes[/u]
Changed the life bars to something more clear and simple 
Changed the UI to a simpler one.
Added more VFX to the game.
Minor updates to some of the stages

notes.title: Chaos Gene 1.6 Update
notes.content:
A first look at 2 of the next Characters for the Chaos Gene Grave and Gideon, as well as a preview of some of the other characters to come. The move set and effects are not final since its still being worked on.

As well as here is a quick update on some of the major and minor changes for the next update.

[olist]
[*] Added Air Block to all the characters
[*] Removed Characters floaty feeling when jumping in the air
[*] Replaced Titan Spinning Punch since Alexandr has a similar move
[*] Updated the options menu
[*] Fixed issue with July and Kurai dash moves
[*] Fixed issue with titan stomp vfx
[*] Changed timing on Syd Demon Flip Kick
[*] Changed Syd's Crouch HK to a Sliding Kick
[*] Changed July Couch Uppercut to a Foot Uppercut
[*] Minor updates to some of the stages
[/olist]

Hopefully this update will be ready for released some time in the next week or so.

notes.title: Chaos Gene Ver 1.1.4 With Story Mode Preview
notes.content:
Chaos Gene Update Ver 1.1.4

This has been mostly a optimization update to help the game run smoother  

[u]Optimization update[/u]
- Changed certain high poly models causing slow down's on certain stages ( Dojo & Bridge stages mainly).
- Changed certain 4k stage textures to 2k or less.
- Reduced all of the character's high poly count.

[img]https://scontent-lax3-1.xx.fbcdn.net/v/t1.0-9/160954327_2741188416141024_2312318156903993403_o.jpg?_nc_cat=110&ccb=1-3&_nc_sid=0debeb&_nc_ohc=IG3brkASJk8AX8wcvXV&_nc_ht=scontent-lax3-1.xx&oh=467a6e45284a158b736682f57a36ebae&oe=6077D1D9[/img]

[u]Game Mode changes[/u]
- A Preview to Story Mode has been added ( Its basically a Arcade mode for now with 7 matches until story mode is finished)
- Alexandr as a Boss Character to Story Mode (Preview to the character Alexandr)

[img]https://scontent-lax3-1.xx.fbcdn.net/v/t1.0-9/128672237_2665996990326834_5129378962400127904_n.jpg?_nc_cat=104&ccb=1-3&_nc_sid=8bfeb9&_nc_ohc=id1gb0M4yAUAX8jXEgH&_nc_ht=scontent-lax3-1.xx&oh=aa3cf9117fb40ceaf786191433b79bf0&oe=607666FF[/img]

[u]Gameplay Changes[/u]
- All of the characters hitboxes have been redone based on feedback
- Syd's Demon Flip Kick frames have been increased  (The kick was to fast)
- Mars, Tiger, and Takeshi link combos have been fixed. (Some link combo's activated crouch attacks with out having to crouch)  

[img]https://scontent-lax3-1.xx.fbcdn.net/v/t1.0-9/160429043_2741188429474356_8767886359502372296_o.jpg?_nc_cat=103&ccb=1-3&_nc_sid=0debeb&_nc_ohc=IaOgacIPJp8AX8QEkew&_nc_ht=scontent-lax3-1.xx&oh=ec908d556cb61640f4e00488a3db7d26&oe=60758255[/img]

[u]Character changes[/u]
- Takeshi Win pose has been changed 
- July Hair style has been changed
- Kurai gloves have been changed to make him look more unique.
- Titans shorts textures have been changed.
- Veronica Shirt was changed and pants texture as well. ( I wanted to give her more character so I changed her textures as well)

[img]https://scontent-lax3-1.xx.fbcdn.net/v/t1.0-9/160924021_2741188316141034_4860575182916968788_o.jpg?_nc_cat=111&ccb=1-3&_nc_sid=0debeb&_nc_ohc=cLI4lm7bX64AX-lB5lV&_nc_ht=scontent-lax3-1.xx&oh=81414ed5b5795aa8756a741fcdc36f8f&oe=607732EB[/img]

[u]Stage Changes[/u]
- Changed the students sitting in the dojo stage
- Reduced the amount of fog on the bridge stages
- Changed the texture's on Hardbody's Gym stage.
